Sauropsis (del griego: σαῦρος ''saûros'', 'lagarto' y griego: ὄψῐς ''ópsis'' 'mirando')<ref>{{cite book |last1=Roberts |first1=George |title=An etymological and explanatory dictionary of the terms and language of geology |date=1839 |publisher=Longman, Orme, Brown, Green, & Longmans |location=London |page=154 |url=https://archive.org/details/anetymologicala00robegoog |access-date=2022-01-01 |language=inglés}}</ref> es un género extinto de [[Osteichthyes|pez óseo]] prehistórico.
